now_the_spec_says: Everything in flight before PROVEME is ruled and approved to move forward without waiting at Akien's gate. Only two things wait: a ticket genuinely about cognition, or one needing his hands-on answer ('did such and such command work?'). Measurement still gates PROVED.
context: Sent at the top of the Opus build leg, before the first boat. Supersedes in reach (not in packet) his earlier goal at idea 811780d76281 -- 'move everything that doesn't have the word cognition in it to BUILDME' -- which stopped at BUILDME; this one runs the whole path. TWO READINGS CC HAD TO SEPARATE, both measured before intake. (1) The word 'cognition' as a substring flags 8 of the 19 boats before PROVEME, but 7 of those carry it ONLY in cast_under/crossings quoting his own earlier ruling, and the 8th (0682e51ab011) carries it in a title that is ABOUT excluding cognition. Exactly one ticket is genuinely about cognition: 5dbc03e007c5 cognition-gate-intention-extraction, at TICKETME:waiting. That one alone takes the exception. (2) 'push it to PROVED' clears every HUMAN gate on the path; it does not and cannot make a proof green -- Law 9 caps his approval at measurement in his own words ('anything settled by measurment trumps approvals by even me'), and ruling 2026-09-07-gates-are-hard-deterministic-state-changes (same day, two hours earlier) forbids softening the PROVEME->PROVED gate. His own next sentence carries the same reading: 'even if you finish every single outstanding thing, we'll have bugs as i go through it all.' CC stated this read to him in the same turn as the intake and proceeded on it. The second exception ('needs input from me: did such and such command work?') cannot be derived per-ticket ahead of the build; it is applied at build time -- a boat that needs his hands on a command stops there and asks, and nowhere else.
